## Fixes

- Claude no longer shows "Claude opened, but its usage panel could not be read" every so often during automatic refreshes, which previously cleared only after pressing **Try again**. UsageDeck now waits until Claude Code is ready before asking for usage, which matters most when several providers refresh at once.
- UsageDeck only submits the usage command once Claude Code shows it has received it. If Claude Code is too slow to respond, UsageDeck reports a temporary problem and checks again shortly, rather than sending anything else to Claude Code.
